Projects | Proof in the field

Solutions applied to real conditions.

No two sites behave exactly the same. These selected examples show how Er-Con adapts technical expertise, proven systems and field execution to the condition, the asset and the surrounding environment.

See the solution in the field.

Every project starts with a different combination of water movement, soil conditions, site geometry and assets at risk. The work shown here represents how Er-Con brings the right capabilities and systems together around those conditions.

Pipeline remediation

Protecting exposed infrastructure.

Erosion and channel change can expose pipeline infrastructure and compromise the surrounding bed and banks. Er-Con develops site-specific stabilization and support solutions around the field conditions and the asset requiring protection.

Bank stabilization

Long-term channel protection.

Changing flow and unstable soils can continue to erode banks and put nearby infrastructure or property at risk. Er-Con addresses both the visible damage and the forces contributing to it.

Channel restoration

Restoring damaged waterways.

Damaged or degrading channels require more than a surface repair. Er-Con combines technical evaluation, constructible design and field execution to establish durable protection.

Project environments

Projects begin with conditions, not categories.

Wherever erosion, changing water flow, channel migration or unstable ground threatens infrastructure, property or natural resources, Er-Con helps protect asset integrity and prevent further erosion and damage to the surrounding area.

  • Pipelines
  • River and Bayou Banks
  • Bridges and Crossings
  • Stormwater Systems
  • Lakes and Ponds
  • Coastal Shorelines
